verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a 'Domain Authentication' feature that verifies sending domains and legitimizes SPF/DKIM setup (sendgrid-docs-9, sendgrid-docs-26), and community notes SendGrid is good at passing SPF/DKIM checks for clients (sendgrid-comm-2). However, the evidence never details DMARC record generation, nor does it show an API endpoint exposing authentication/verification status programmatically. missing for 10: explicit DMARC record generation, documented API for checking domain-authentication verification status, evidence of end-to-end automated verification flow.
